rec.name: PDP Video Play Button (Gallery Overlay with Fullscreen Video Popup)
rec.status: Built — launched (QS passed, documentation written; instructions being made theme-agnostic)

what.text: A small round or square thumbnail with a play icon is overlaid on the product gallery images. It uses the product's featured video (or a custom thumbnail). On click, the video opens in a fullscreen black popup with native controls and autoplay. The popup closes via the X button, a click on the backdrop, or the Escape key, and the product page is visible again. The button can sit in any of the four corners, appear on the first image only or on all images, and be a circle or a square. It is rebuilt from the Focal theme's native video play button and is configured in the theme editor under the product section's Media settings as 'Video Play Button'.

why.text: Product video answers questions that static images can't: real size, how it looks when worn, texture, and movement. That reduces uncertainty and return risk. A small preview thumbnail in the corner of the gallery draws attention without interrupting the shopping flow, and it is opt-in, so there is no autoplay annoyance. The popup shows the video large and distraction-free, and shoppers return straight to the product and the buy box. Seeing the item in use also acts as informal social proof and builds trust.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet video-play-button.liquid. It reads the product metafield standard.featured_video (video source URL) and an optional featured_video_thumbnail, falling back to the video's preview image. It renders a <video-play-button> custom element with a thumbnail, an overlay and a CSS play triangle. 2) Create the snippet video-play-button-popup.liquid, containing a fullscreen popup container, a close button, a lightweight JS class (VideoPlayButton extends HTMLElement) and CSS. The class creates the <video> element on open, removes it on close, closes on Escape or backdrop click, and locks page scroll via a class on <html>. The CSS positions the button according to the section settings; it is 54px on mobile and 100px at 1024px and wider. 3) Add three select settings to the product section schema (main-product.liquid): position (top_left/top_right/bottom_left/bottom_right, default top_right), fixing (first/all, default all) and format (circle/square, default circle). 4) Inside the media image wrapper (.product__media-image-wrapper), render the video-play-button snippet if the featured_video metafield exists; if fixing is 'first', render it only when forloop.index == 1. 5) In main-product.liquid, render the popup snippet once if the metafield exists. Because the button renders inside the main product section, it cannot be a standalone section. Theme file names and structure may differ, so the instructions must be made theme-independent. The ticket also notes that pasting schema lines at the very end of the JSON causes a syntax error, so the placement must be explained clearly.

items: Position: top left / top right / bottom left / bottom right (default: top right)
Fixing the video: show on first product image only / show on all product images (default: all)
Optional per-product thumbnail via metafield featured_video_thumbnail (otherwise the video preview image is used)
Autoplay and controls are set as attributes on the custom element (both true by default)

dependencies.text: Product metafield standard.featured_video (Shopify's native video metafield; the button only renders if it is filled). Optional metafield standard.featured_video_thumbnail. Shopify theme based on Focal (the Focal main-product section and the .product__media-image-wrapper element); other themes need adapted file names and insertion points. Must be installed by a developer (code in 2 snippets plus 3 edits in main-product.liquid), so no-code installation by non-devs isn't possible yet. No app required; the custom lightweight JS replaces the dependency on the theme's ed-custom.js.

items: Video play rate (clicks on the play button / PDP sessions)
Add-to-cart rate for sessions with vs. without a video play
PDP conversion rate (A/B: with vs. without the button)
Return rate on products with video (long-term)
Bounce rate and scroll depth on the PDP

images.caption: Live example (hnds.de): round video thumbnail with a play icon in the top-right corner of the first product image
Theme editor: 'Video Play Button' settings (Position, Fixing the video, Format) in the product section, and the circular button on the product image
Fullscreen black video popup with native controls and an X close button at the top right
Existing Focal theme Media settings block, directly above where the Video Play Button settings are added
